regDeaths.name: a toad like a war drum, throat swelling
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
a shadow moving wrong against the sun
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
stripes flowing where no wind blows
